name: invincible-video-director
description: Operate existing Invincible Creator Studio projects with bounded reads, asset lookup, revision-safe scene patches and preview export.

interface.longDescription: Reads the existing Motion Studio draft and private asset library, then applies bounded scene patches while preserving project IDs, voiceover timing, stable scene IDs and unrelated layers.
defaultPrompt: Read this Creator Studio draft and patch only the selected scene.
Export a JPG preview of the selected scene.
